Bastar region peak during cool season October–March. Monsoon June–August brings rain and reduced visitor footfall.
Eternal spring climate means year-round hiking; peak is cool/dry months October–May. Monsoon June–September sees fewer trekkers.
Tea estate and wildlife viewing peak in cool season October–March. Monsoon June–August reduces plantation tours and gibbon sightings.
Heritage fort tourism peaks October–February during cool months. May–June are hottest and driest; minimal tourists.
Island diving and water sports safe October–May with calm seas. Monsoon June–September brings rough waves and dive restrictions.
Spring flowers March–May and autumn October–November attract orchid/nursery visitors. Monsoon June–August is quietest.
Temple pilgrims and silk shoppers peak October–March in cool weather. April–June too hot for temple visits.

Rock-cut caves visited October–March in cool season. Monsoon and summer (June–September) see minimal visitors.
